<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

Open a chat of a running sandbox in the agent's own terminal UI, in this terminal. The terminal UI runs in the sandbox and keeps running when you detach, so you can come back to it, also from another terminal, and the chat in VS Code or the app's page follows what you do there.

SANDBOX is a sandbox running on this computer (its project name, its id as the app's page shows it, e.g. local-1a2b3c4d, or a number from "codeflower chats"), one added to "codeflower client", or the codeflower://… line a sandbox printed. With one sandbox it can be left out. CHAT is a chat's number from "codeflower chats", the start of its title, or its key; without it (and without --new or --last) you choose from a list.

After Enter, type ~. to detach, ~s to switch to another chat, ~q to quit the terminal UI, ~l for links, ~o to open the file the agent showed last, or ~? for help.

Files the agent shows (codeflower-show) appear as links that open them in your browser, in the page of "codeflower client": on this computer's page, or over SSH through remote access (codeflower tunnel pair) when it is on.

OpenCode's and Codex's terminal UIs share the chat with VS Code and the app's page: each shows and can continue it. Claude Code's takes the chat over while it runs (after the chat's current turn): the page and VS Code follow it, and what they send is typed into it, until you quit it (~q), when they have the chat again. DeepSeek Harness has no terminal UI.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower attach [SANDBOX] [CHAT] [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
  codeflower attach
  codeflower attach study42 --last
  codeflower attach study42 "PCA of batch 3"
  codeflower attach study42 --new --agent codex
  ssh -t login-node codeflower attach study42 --last
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--agent string` |  | agent of a new chat: claude, codex or opencode (default: asked, unless only one has a terminal UI) |
| `--config string` |  | config directory, whose running client's page the links open (or set $CODEFLOWER_CONFIG; default ~/.codeflower) |
| `--last` |  | open the chat that changed last |
| `--links string` | `auto` | where the files the agent shows open: auto (this computer's page, through remote access over SSH), local, tunnel, or path (no links) |
| `--new` |  | start a new chat |
| `--watch` |  | only watch: what you type is not sent |
